image: Pick a file or upload one. The alt text comes from the file itself: set it in Content → Files.
ts_style: Media: photos, filling the frame on light gray. Logo: client logos, gray, in color on hover. Logo in a row: small color logo. Wordmark: a brand-name logo.
ts_span: Leave as is: already set where it's used. In a photo grid it makes one photo take 2 columns, 2 rows or both.
ts_min_height: Leave as is. The least height of a photo beside text on large screens (for example a hero photo); longer text still makes the row taller.
ts_caption: A short label in the bottom corner of the photo, for example what it shows. Leave blank for none.
ts_contain: For a part on a white background or a drawing: shows the whole image, never cropped. Keep it off for photos.
ts_max_height: Limits the height of the whole image, centred in its space. 0 lets it fill the space.
ts_fill_top: Leave empty. Used once, for an image with its own gray background: the colour of the image's top edge fills the space above it.
ts_fill_bottom: Leave empty. The colour of the image's bottom edge, filling the space below it.
ts_copy_first: For a group of photos beside text: below 990 pixels the text comes first, then the photos.
ts_focus_y: Where a cropped photo is cut: 0% keeps the top, 50% the middle, 100% the bottom.
image_ratio: The frame's shape. Auto keeps the image's own shape; Portrait is 4:5, Landscape 16:9. Keep one shape per row.
width: Leave as is: the layout around the image depends on it.
width_mobile: Leave as is: the layout around the image depends on it.
border: Leave on None: images on this site have no border.
border_radius: Leave at 0px: the site's images have square corners.
